evidence_status: Frozen software-audit configuration only; passing does not establish semantic independence, privacy clearance, or experimental validity.

similarity.record_candidate_signature: union of per-segment character 5-grams; exhaustive mode evaluates every cross-record segment pair

limitations: Character n-gram similarity is a deterministic lexical heuristic, not a semantic-independence certificate.

MinHash LSH candidate generation above the exhaustive limit can miss qualifying pairs, so it is inconclusive unless a frozen reviewed exact engine supplies a hash-bound, gap-free audit of all n*(n-1)/2 pairs.
The current external exact-engine contract is record-pair v1 and cannot clear a multi-field artifact; a reviewed segment-pair sharding contract is required before large real exports can pass.
The detectors do not cover multilingual paraphrase, images, audio, or legal and human-subjects review.
A passing ledger cannot approve a pending manual review in the public-source registry.
